source.statement: Maintainer Aoife decisions under ROOT-REVIEW-001 amend the unpublished contract 0.4.0 and CORE-PLATFORM-001 0.6.0 in place. Decision A: after startup sending and ultimate success precedence, a started publication with any HTTP 2xx response but no usable successful result is unconfirmed; actual HTTP 2xx attempts still count as answered and accepted. Acknowledged failure requires every attempt answered with no 2xx acceptance. Durable intent still precedes HTTP and failed intent sends zero requests. Decision B: retention freezes recorded parent volume/object identities and observes parent identity, fingerprint, parent identity on the worker. Missing, unstable, unknown or changed parent identity keeps keys; stable unchanged fingerprints can unanimously nominate an unrecorded identity for later writes only. Recorded identities are never refreshed and unreferenced identities are dropped. Checkpoint v2 adds parents with absolute paths and 1-20 ASCII digit device/inode strings, missing-on-read means empty, malformed or duplicate entries fail closed, and every v2 write includes parents. Version 1 stays readable and upgrades on write; v1-only binaries refuse v2. Decision C: a session is one application process; Stop/Start does not reset answered failure attempts, while cancelled unsent work stays retryable. Explicit Upload file is independent of watch holds; changing the file creates a new key. Local copy/move publication remains unchanged. Notices expose at most five basenames plus the remainder count, with no paths or URLs. Private store limits and unbounded exit draining remain accepted follow-ups; no new UI, rules-store version, identity-refresh policy or shutdown mechanism is authorized. The other 15 packages carry forward to contract 0.4.0 unchanged in normative text from 0.3.2, where the 2026-11-14 ES empty-save baseline record approved them; the implementer verified that carry-forward by diffing the capability packages against commit 81220c40109a1fed1f1ec4747f9f62d02e0c5a8a and found differences only in CORE-PLATFORM-001. No other product-semantic change is made, and no ROOT constitution rule is changed.
